evidence.claim: Graph-feature scorer trained on 5,565 closed cases gives this transaction a calibrated fraud probability of 0.05 (bank model score 0.87); features include Vesta's unnamed C, D, M and V columns, used as signals only
Card has 2178 earlier transactions in billing region 264.0; not a new region
Match flags M6 show a mismatch (Vesta match flags; exact meaning unpublished)
Card history holds 12 earlier closed cases (12 confirmed fraud, 0 cleared); most recent CC-5521 (account_takeover, confirmed_fraud)

Known-pattern definition matched to this case: Out-of-region use. Card-present purchases in a billing region the cardholder has no history in, while their normal activity continues at home. Several days of purchases in one new region is a trip, not a clone. Policy R2, R3.
Closed cases whose analyst notes read most like this investigation (vector search over ClosedCase.note_emb): CC-5062, CC-0657, CC-3366, CC-2533

case.summary: Real-time model flagged transaction 3514948 ($111.92, in-person, region 264.0) at score 0.87. Graph-feature scorer recalibrated fraud probability to 0.05 using trained signals and card history. Card shows 2,178 prior transactions in region 264.0—established cardholder activity, not new territory. Verdict: legitimate. Transaction allowed, case closed.

stop_reason: Probability 0.05 with 2 independent signals meets the §6 stopping rule; the risk score alone did not hold up.
